ERP sync badges are correctly implemented but not visible because no entries have been synced to FortexaERP yet (expected behavior).

context_for_next_testing_agent: FortexaERP visual indicator feature implemented. The ERP sync badge (green badge with FortexaERP logo and 'ERP' text) will only appear when a journal entry has been synced to FortexaERP (has fortexaerp_entry_id in DB). To see the badge: 1) Configure FortexaERP in Company Config > Integrations, 2) Go to Accounting page, 3) Click export dropdown on a payroll entry, 4) Click 'FortexaERP' to sync. After successful sync, the green ERP badge will appear next to the Status/Period Status column.
